# Expert for
# SMB Resellers

## Webshop and Cloud

## ALSO has the right offer for you

Create holistic IT solutions with ALSO. Innovative applications from IoT to AI, from cybersecurity
to gaming. Sustainable processes and competent services. And all from a single source.

Learn more about our company, our strategy, and our approach towards sustainable IT.

* [Discover ALSO][89]

## Webshop for IT partners

### Intelligent IT Supply

[Two people in a warehouse looking at a tablet together]

Find everything you need for your customers' IT in our shop. And with our e-commerce services, you
can integrate the products directly into your own shop system. Or even easier, simply use
**myStore,** the white-label solution for your digital marketplace.

Buy smart. Sell smart.

* [Explore our webshop][90]

## Cloud

### Marketplace, Gaming Place, IoT, AI, Cybersecurity

[Two people in a datacenter discussing solutions ]

### From technology to solution

Our solutions stack runs deep.

Expand your business with Everything-as-a-Service (XaaS), cloud solutions with ALSO Cloud
Marketplace, and platforms for AI, IoT, virtualization, and cloud gaming.

And our value-added services support you with such complex issues as migrations, automation or
security concepts.

* [Explore our Cloud][91]

## Value Added Services

### Discover the services behind the technology

[Woman presenting statistics to a group of people in a meeting room]

### A partnership with ALSO positions your business at the center of an extensive ecosystem

Experience personalized service backed by teams of experts and a vast array of solutions such as

* Professional Services,
* Finance and Logistics Services,
* Premium Support,
* Cloud Management Services, and
* Migration Assessments.

We’ll keep you connected, competitive, and support your business across the digital landscape and
throughout the cloud.

* [Explore Value Added Services][92]

[Image of business people shaking hands after becoming partners]

## Become an ALSO Partner

Partnership is profitable. With ALSO.
